objective: Screen two cross-asset defensive-trend sleeves (D1 Carlson Defense First TAA, D2 12-month-vs-SHY absolute momentum with inverse-63-session-vol sizing), each against the frozen K1/K2 tiers, for whether adding one to S3 raises combined Sharpe over delevering S3 alone at the same risk.

vol_matched_delevered_control_ci.description: Ci = k*S3 + (1-k)*SHY for the paired candidate; k in (0,1] solved by bisection separately per evaluation window so std(Ci daily return) == std(candidate-combined daily return) over that window; k capped at 1.0 if the combination's volatility >= S3's. Rebalanced daily at the fixed per-window k, no cost (conservative in the control's favor). Ported unchanged from run_h20260927_01_sleeve_combination via screen_lane.combine_two_sleeves / diversifier_edge_for_offset.

per_candidate: K2 (primary): judged (median-offset) combination Sharpe minus vol-matched delevered-S3 control Sharpe >= 0.05 in BOTH anchor and stress
K1 (fallback): standalone judged (median-offset) Sharpe at 10bp >= 80% of S3's own median Sharpe in both windows (anchor bar 1.19, stress bar 0.65), AND 20bp CAGR positive in both windows
adoption_rule.pass_requires: D1 or D2 clears K2 or K1
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: two candidates (D1, D2); report both regardless of outcome; DSR at n_trials=2
adoption_rule.fallback_if_none_pass: no cross-asset sleeve added to the live pilot on this evidence; keep S3 alone
